verdict.rationale: Pricing transparency is a fair question for a domain registrar, but the evidence pack has no Porkbun at-cost claim, registry fee breakdown, or published low-margin guarantee. The pricing-lookup API (docs-35) only exposes prices. Community reports conflict: some users find Porkbun cheaper than Namecheap on renewals, while others say its prices are equal to or higher than most registrars. Neither side establishes near-wholesale pricing.
